13: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.dashboard_contact_counts(
14:   p_since timestamptz DEFAULT NULL,
15:   p_until timestamptz DEFAULT NULL,
16:   p_queue uuid DEFAULT NULL,
17:   p_agent uuid DEFAULT NULL
18: )
19: RETURNS jsonb
20: LANGUAGE sql
21: STABLE
22: AS $body$
23:   WITH filtered AS (
24:     SELECT c.id, c.queue_id, c.assigned_to, c.conversation_status
25:     FROM contacts c
26:     WHERE (p_queue IS NULL OR c.queue_id = p_queue)
27:       AND (p_agent IS NULL OR c.assigned_to = p_agent)
28:       AND (p_since IS NULL OR c.updated_at >= p_since)
29:       AND (p_until IS NULL OR c.updated_at <= p_until)
30:       AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
31:   ),
32:   sla_today AS (
33:     SELECT s.contact_id, s.first_message_at, s.first_response_at, s.first_response_breached
34:     FROM conversation_sla s
35:     WHERE s.first_message_at >= date_trunc('day', now())
36:   ),
37:   per_queue AS (
38:     SELECT
39:       f.queue_id,
40:       count(*) FILTER (WHERE f.assigned_to IS NULL) AS waiting,
41:       count(*) FILTER (WHERE f.assigned_to IS NOT NULL) AS in_service,
42:       round((avg(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (st.first_response_at - st.first_message_at)))
43:              FILTER (WHERE st.first_response_at IS NOT NULL))::numeric) AS avg_response,
44:       round((100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE st.first_response_breached IS FALSE)
45:              / NULLIF(count(*) FILTER (WHERE st.contact_id IS NOT NULL), 0))::numeric) AS sla_rate
46:     FROM filtered f
47:     LEFT JOIN sla_today st ON st.contact_id = f.id
48:     WHERE f.queue_id IS NOT NULL
49:     GROUP BY f.queue_id
50:   )
51:   SELECT jsonb_build_object(
52:     'total', (SELECT count(*) FROM filtered),
53:     'open', (SELECT count(*) FROM filtered WHERE assigned_to IS NOT NULL AND conversation_status = 'open'),
54:     'pending', (SELECT count(*) FROM filtered WHERE assigned_to IS NULL AND queue_id IS NOT NULL AND conversation_status NOT IN ('resolved', 'archived')),
55:     'myActive', (SELECT count(*) FROM filtered WHERE assigned_to = auth.uid()),
56:     'queues', COALESCE((
57:       SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
58:         'queueId', queue_id,
59:         'waiting', waiting,
60:         'inService', in_service,
61:         'avgResponse', avg_response,
62:         'slaRate', sla_rate
63:       ))
64:       FROM per_queue
65:     ), '[]'::jsonb)
66:   );
67: $body$;

34: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.list_multiplix_claimable_items(
35:   p_dispatch_id uuid,
36:   p_limit integer DEFAULT 5
37: )
38: RETURNS TABLE(
39:   item_id uuid,
40:   recipient_id uuid,
41:   block_id uuid,
42:   -- smallint, NAO integer: a coluna e multiplix_blocks.block_order smallint, e o RETURNS TABLE
43:   -- tem de casar tipo a tipo com o RETURN QUERY (senao: 'structure of query does not match
44:   -- function result type'). Achado pelo harness, nao por leitura.
45:   block_order smallint,
46:   company_id uuid,
47:   attempt_count integer,
48:   next_attempt_at timestamp with time zone
49: )
50: LANGUAGE plpgsql
51: SECURITY DEFINER
52: SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
53: AS $function$
54: BEGIN
55:   IF COALESCE(auth.role(), '') <> 'service_role' THEN
56:     RAISE EXCEPTION 'service_role_required' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
57:   END IF;
58:   IF p_dispatch_id IS NULL
59:      OR p_limit IS NULL OR p_limit NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 100 THEN
60:     RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_multiplix_claimable_list' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
61:   END IF;
62: 
63:   RETURN QUERY
64:   SELECT item.id,
65:          item.recipient_id,
66:          item.block_id,
67:          blk.block_order,
68:          recipient.company_id,
69:          item.attempt_count,
70:          item.next_attempt_at
71:     FROM public.multiplix_delivery_items AS item
72:     JOIN public.multiplix_dispatches AS dispatch ON dispatch.id = item.dispatch_id
73:     JOIN public.multiplix_recipients AS recipient ON recipient.id = item.recipient_id
74:     JOIN public.multiplix_blocks AS blk ON blk.id = item.block_id
75:    WHERE item.dispatch_id = p_dispatch_id
76:      AND dispatch.status = 'sending'
77:      -- Estado elegivel, igual ao do claim_multiplix_item (F32b): 'sending' so se o lease
78:      -- venceu E o envio ao provedor ainda nao comecou — item que ja foi ao provedor nunca
79:      -- e reciclado por aqui, quem resolve e o sweeper (outcome_unknown).
80:      AND (
81:        item.status IN ('pending', 'failed_transient')
82:        OR (
83:          item.status = 'sending'
84:          AND item.lease_until <= statement_timestamp()
85:          AND item.provider_dispatch_started_at IS NULL
86:        )
87:      )
88:      -- Backoff por item (F12 transportado ao item): nao entregar antes da hora.
89:      AND (item.next_attempt_at IS NULL OR item.next_attempt_at <= statement_timestamp())
90:      -- F56 · ORDEM POR DESTINATARIO: o bloco anterior deste MESMO destinatario precisa estar
91:      -- concluido. 'delivered'/'read' contam como concluido porque sao posteriores a 'sent'
92:      -- no ciclo de vida; 'sent' e o piso que o F56 nomeia.
93:      AND NOT EXISTS (
94:        SELECT 1
95:          FROM public.multiplix_delivery_items AS prev
96:          JOIN public.multiplix_blocks AS prev_blk ON prev_blk.id = prev.block_id
97:         WHERE prev.dispatch_id = item.dispatch_id
98:           AND prev.recipient_id = item.recipient_id
99:           AND prev_blk.block_order = blk.block_order - 1
100:           AND prev.status NOT IN ('sent', 'delivered', 'read')
101:      )
102:    -- Ordem de trabalho: primeiro quem nunca tentou / ja passou o backoff, depois o mais
103:    -- antigo. Determinismo importa: dois workers chamando isto N vezes seguidas precisam
104:    -- enxergar a mesma fila (o desempate final e o id).
105:    ORDER BY blk.block_order, item.next_attempt_at NULLS FIRST, item.created_at, item.id
106:    LIMIT p_limit;
107: END;
108: $function$;
109: 
110: REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.list_multiplix_claimable_items(uuid, integer) FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated;
111: GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.list_multiplix_claimable_items(uuid, integer) TO service_role;

247: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.record_multiplix_item_sent(p_item_id uuid, p_claim_token uuid, p_external_id text)
248: RETURNS void
249: LANGUAGE plpgsql
250: SECURITY DEFINER
251: SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
252: AS $function$
253: DECLARE
254:   v_dispatch_id uuid;
255:   v_external_id text := NULLIF(btrim(p_external_id), '');
256: BEGIN
257:   IF COALESCE(auth.role(), '') <> 'service_role' THEN
258:     RAISE EXCEPTION 'service_role_required' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
259:   END IF;
260:   IF p_item_id IS NULL OR p_claim_token IS NULL
261:      OR v_external_id IS NULL OR length(v_external_id) > 512 THEN
262:     RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_multiplix_delivery_receipt' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
263:   END IF;
264: 
265:   PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(v_external_id, 0));
266:   IF EXISTS (
267:     SELECT 1
268:     FROM public.multiplix_delivery_items AS duplicate
269:     WHERE duplicate.external_id = v_external_id
270:       AND duplicate.id <> p_item_id
271:   ) THEN
272:     RAISE EXCEPTION 'multiplix_provider_receipt_already_recorded' USING ERRCODE = '23505';
273:   END IF;
274: 
275:   UPDATE public.multiplix_delivery_items AS item
276:      SET status = 'sent',
277:          sent_at = statement_timestamp(),
278:          external_id = v_external_id,
279:          error_message = NULL,
280:          error_class = NULL,
281:          lease_token = NULL,
282:          lease_until = NULL,
283:          worker_id = NULL,
284:          updated_at = statement_timestamp()
285:    WHERE item.id = p_item_id
286:      AND item.status = 'sending'
287:      AND item.lease_token = p_claim_token
288:      AND item.provider_dispatch_started_at IS NOT NULL
289:   RETURNING item.dispatch_id INTO v_dispatch_id;
290: 
291:   IF NOT FOUND THEN
292:     RAISE EXCEPTION 'multiplix_delivery_claim_conflict' USING ERRCODE = 'P0002';
293:   END IF;
294: 
295:   -- contador recalculado (idempotente) — ver §1 do cabecalho
296:   UPDATE public.multiplix_dispatches AS dispatch
297:      SET sent_count = (
298:            SELECT count(*) FROM public.multiplix_delivery_items AS i
299:             WHERE i.dispatch_id = dispatch.id
300:               AND i.status IN ('sent', 'delivered', 'read')
301:          ),
302:          updated_at = statement_timestamp()
303:    WHERE dispatch.id = v_dispatch_id;
304: END;
305: $function$;

334:       error_message = NULLIF(btrim(p_error_message), ''),

336:       lease_until = NULL,
337:       worker_id = NULL,
338:       updated_at = statement_timestamp()
339:   WHERE item.id = p_item_id
340:     AND item.status = 'sending'
341:     AND item.lease_token = p_claim_token

355:         SELECT count(*) FROM public.multiplix_delivery_items AS i
356:          WHERE i.dispatch_id = dispatch.id AND i.status = 'outcome_unknown'

595:   v_status text;
596: BEGIN
597:   IF COALESCE(auth.role(), '') <> 'service_role' THEN
598:     RAISE EXCEPTION 'service_role_required' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
599:   END IF;
600:   IF p_dispatch_id IS NULL THEN
601:     RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_multiplix_dispatch_id' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
602:   END IF;
603: 
604:   SELECT dispatch.status
605:     INTO v_status
606:     FROM public.multiplix_dispatches AS dispatch
607:    WHERE dispatch.id = p_dispatch_id
608:    FOR UPDATE;
609: 
610:   IF NOT FOUND THEN
611:     RAISE EXCEPTION 'multiplix_dispatch_not_found' USING ERRCODE = 'P0002';
612:   END IF;
613: 
614:   IF v_status <> 'sending' THEN
615:     RETURN false;
616:   END IF;
617: 
618:   -- `failed_transient` e o estado de retry da fila por item (§3 do cabecalho).
619:   IF EXISTS (
620:     SELECT 1
621:       FROM public.multiplix_delivery_items AS item
622:      WHERE item.dispatch_id = p_dispatch_id
623:        AND item.status IN ('pending', 'sending', 'failed_transient')
624:   ) THEN
625:     RETURN false;
626:   END IF;
627: 
628:   UPDATE public.multiplix_dispatches AS dispatch
629:      SET status = CASE
630:            WHEN dispatch.failed_count + dispatch.outcome_unknown_count > 0 THEN 'completed_with_failures'
631:            ELSE 'completed'
632:          END,
633:          completed_at = statement_timestamp(),
634:          updated_at = statement_timestamp()
635:    WHERE dispatch.id = p_dispatch_id
636:      AND dispatch.status = 'sending';
